integrity: Symbolic all-field proof and independently replayable finite-field enumeration; no independent audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies ordinary derivations of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra and their full Lie-automorphism action, not derivations preserving any restricted p-mapping or higher Heisenberg rank. Finite verifier is corroboration; all-characteristic proof is symbolic. Equivalent real-flow normal forms remain a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Complete automorphism-conjugacy orbits of derivations of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
